expected.subject: Sophie, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Sophie,

I'm with Legora, the legal AI platform for Litigation used by partners at Goodwin and White & Case.

You're probably still spending too much time overseeing associates manually reviewing pleadings, discovery documents, and case law deal after deal.

I'd love to share the use cases that other attorneys are using heavily for similar work in your practice area and hear your thoughts.

Would you be interested in joining one of our live demo webinars?

William
Legora

notes: Barton Chambers Associate, 4 lawyers, UK. Junior title → SMB → webinar CTA. No title_line since associate = junior.
